::: {#rem-representation}

#### The same failure with people

A [training set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-training-set) with few eights is a small case of what [Ethics and Fairness](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/ethics.html#sec-bias-sources) in the DATA 571 notes calls representation bias:
a group that appears less often in the [training set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-training-set) gets less of the network's [accuracy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/metrics.html#def-accuracy).
The commercial face-analysis systems among [its documented cases](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/ethics.html#sec-documented-cases) failed in this way,
and evaluating them separately on groups of faces is what showed it [@buolamwini2018gender].

:::
